name: Patrick

attributes.attribute: the name of the Irish saint

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Patrick See St. Patrick. The name belongs to the Irish saint and folkloric hero. No fifth-century writer mentions him. Gildas and Bede never refer to a man of this name. Some scholars doubt he existed. Most writers agree that folk motifs gathered around a historic figure.

okr.objective: Describe Patrick and the record of the Irish saint.
key_results: The name Patrick belongs to the Irish saint and hero.
No fifth-century writer names him directly, which raises doubt.
Most writers agree folkloric motifs gathered around a historic figure.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
